asChild.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Call `props()` to spread the part's props, passing your own to merge them rather than overwrite them.
The state arrives as an accessor:
`render={(props, state) => <button {...props({ onClick: mine })}>{state().open}</button>}`

closeOnSelect.description: Whether to close the color picker when a swatch is selected

defaultFormat.description:
The initial color format when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the color format of the color picker.

defaultOpen.description:
The initial open state of the color picker when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the color picker.

defaultValue.description:
The initial color value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the color value of the color picker.

disabled.description: Whether the color picker is disabled

format.description: The controlled color format to use

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the color picker. Useful for composition.

immediate.description: Whether to synchronize the present change immediately or defer it to the next frame

initialFocusEl.description: The initial focus element when the color picker is opened.

inline.description: Whether to render the color picker inline

invalid.description: Whether the color picker is invalid

name.description: The name for the form input

onEnterComplete.description: Function called when the animation ends in the open state

onExitComplete.description: Function called when the animation ends in the closed state

onFocusOutside.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

onFormatChange.description: Function called when the color format changes

onInteractOutside.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

onOpenChange.description: Handler that is called when the user opens or closes the color picker.

onPointerDownOutside.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

onValueChange.description: Handler that is called when the value changes, as the user drags.

onValueChangeEnd.description: Handler that is called when the user stops dragging.

open.description: The controlled open state of the color picker

openAutoFocus.description: Whether to auto focus the color picker when it is opened

positioning.description: The positioning options for the color picker

present.description: Whether the node is present (controlled by the user)

readOnly.description: Whether the color picker is read-only
